title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Issues concerning the Time Effectiveness of the Application of Criminal Judicial Interpretations

articles.content_en: A judicial interpretation is a legally binding interpretation made by the Supreme People's Court on the specific application of laws in adjudication work and by the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the specific application of laws in procuratorial work. It shall come into force as of the date of its issuance or the date specified, and its validity shall apply during the period in which the law is in effect.

With respect to conduct that occurred before the implementation of the judicial interpretation, where there was no relevant judicial interpretation at the time of the conduct, cases that have not yet been handled or are being handled after the judicial interpretation comes into force shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of the judicial interpretation.

With respect to conduct that occurred before the implementation of a new judicial interpretation, where there was already a relevant judicial interpretation at the time of the conduct, it shall be handled in accordance with the judicial interpretation at the time of the conduct. However, if applying the new judicial interpretation is favorable to the criminal suspect or defendant, the new judicial interpretation shall apply.

With respect to cases that have been concluded before the judicial interpretation comes into force, if there are no errors in the determination of facts and application of law in accordance with the law and judicial interpretations at that time, they shall not be altered.
